entries.title: Gluon Bound States: X(2370) Glueball Discovery at BESIII
entries.rationale: First confirmed glueball - pure binding energy creating mass. Direct window into quantum vacuum structure and non-perturbative QCD. Bridges quantum gravity (mass from fields) and topological systems.

entries.title: Quantum Speed Limit for Thermalization Proven
entries.rationale: Fundamental bound on how fast quantum systems thermalize. Critical for understanding black hole information, quantum computing stability, and the arrow of time.

entries.title: DNA Flight Recorder: Embryonic Development Traced Cell-by-Cell
entries.rationale: Biological assembly index in action - tracking how complex organisms build themselves from single cells. Direct analog to cosmological structure formation.

entries.title: Dual Feeding Black Holes at 175 Parsecs: Galaxy Merger Dynamics
entries.rationale: Closest confirmed dual AGN - testing galaxy merger models and supermassive black hole binary evolution. Empirical anchor for gravitational wave background predictions.

entries.title: 10-Second Quantum Entanglement Achieved for Computing
entries.rationale: Record coherence times enabling practical quantum computing. Critical threshold for neuromorphic-quantum hybrid systems and Cloud-9 quantum bridge validation.

entries.title: Work Extraction from Hidden Degrees of Freedom: Maxwell Demon Realized
entries.rationale: Experimental realization of information-to-work conversion. Deep implications for biological systems, computation thermodynamics, and the physics of life.

entries.title: JWST Detects Signal from "Empty" Void: Structure Formation Challenge
entries.rationale: JWST finding structure where none should exist - direct test case for Assembly Index detecting non-random complexity in unexpected places.

entries.title: Quantum Probability Cannot Be Derived Without Assuming It
entries.rationale: Deep foundational result - quantum probability structure is irreducible. Constraints on any future unified theory and the interpretation of quantum mechanics.
